[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided tips on how to pack light for the LA trip, including:

[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Choose versatile pieces that can be mixed and matched.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Limit yourself to a color palette of core colors.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Pack multipurpose items.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Roll clothes to save space and reduce wrinkles.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Pack essentials only and be ruthless about what you bring.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Use packing cubes or organizers for better organization.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 8. Wear bulky items on the plane.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 9. Pack layers for unpredictable weather.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 10. Check the weather forecast before the trip.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] For a 3-5 day trip to LA, consider packing: 3-4 tops, 2-3 bottoms, 1-2 dresses or jumpsuits, 1-2 light jackets, undergarments, comfortable walking shoes, dress shoes, and accessories.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant suggested doing laundry or purchasing items once in LA if needed.
